lines: Title: Image of Frame under Frame Homomorphism is Frame/Corollary
Let $\phi: S_1 \to S_2$ be a [[Definition:Frame Homomorphism|frame homomorphism]].
Let $L_3 = \struct{S_3, \preceq_3}$ be the [[Definition:Ordered Set|ordered set]] where:
:$S_3$ denotes the [[Definition:Image of Subset under Mapping|image]] of $S_1$ under $\phi$
:$\preceq_3$ denotes the [[Definition:Restricted Ordering|restricted ordering]] of $\preceq_2$ to the [[Definition:Subset|subset]] $S_3$.
:$\phi \restriction_{S_1 \times S_3}$ denotes the [[Definition:Restriction of Mapping|restriction]] of the [[Definition:Mapping|mapping]] of $\phi$ to $S_1 \times S_3$
=== {{Lemma|Image of Frame under Frame Homomorphism is Frame|1|Lemma 1}} ===
Let $\bigvee T$ denote the [[Definition:Supremum of Set|supremum]] of $T$ in $L_2$.
=== {{Lemma|Image of Frame under Frame Homomorphism is Frame|2|Lemma 2}} ===
Let $F \subseteq S_3$ be a [[Definition:Finite Subset|finite subset]].
Let $\bigwedge F$ denote the [[Definition:Infimum of Set|infimum]] of $F$ in $L_2$.
Let $\phi: S_1 \to S_2$ be a [[Definition:Mapping|mapping]] between the underlying [[Definition:Set|sets]] of $L_1$ and $L_2$.
:$\phi$ is a '''[[Definition:Frame Homomorphism|frame homomorphism]]''', denoted $\phi: L_1 \to L_2$
:$\phi$ is [[Definition:Finite Meet Preserving Mapping|finite meet preserving]] and [[Definition:Arbitrary Join Preserving Mapping|arbitrary join preserving]]
| c = {{Lemma|Image of Frame under Frame Homomorphism is Frame|1|Lemma 1}}
where ${\bigvee}_1, {\bigvee}_2, {\bigvee}_3$ denotes the [[Definition:Supremum of Set|supremum]] in $L_1, L_2, L_3$ respectively.
It follows that $\phi \restriction_{S_1 \times S_3 }$ is [[Definition:Arbitrary Join Preserving Mapping|arbitrary join preserving]] by definition.
Let $F \subseteq S_3$ be a [[DefinitiOn:Finite Set|finite set]].
| c = {{Lemma|Image of Frame under Frame Homomorphism is Frame|2|Lemma 2}}
where ${\bigwedge}_1, {\bigwedge}_2, {\bigwedge}_3$ denotes the [[Definition:Infimum of Set|infimum]] in $L_1, L_2, L_3$ respectively.
It follows that $\phi \restriction_{S_1 \times S_3 }$ is [[Definition:Finite Meet Preserving Mapping|finite meet preserving]] by definition.
